name: Tejpatta
kitchenUse: One or two leaves fried in ghee at the start of cooking dal, pulao or curry, then removed before eating.

typicalUse.note: Remove the whole leaf before serving; it does not soften and can be a choking hazard.

cautions.note: Take whole leaves out of food before serving children; they can catch in the throat.

interactions.effect: Medicinal amounts have been studied for lowering blood sugar and may add to diabetes medicines.

evidence.summary: Mostly laboratory and animal studies; very little research in people.
